mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we are looking at 56 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a waxing crescent moon. The ISS is passing overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the cloud cover.

In city news, there were no new emails received today. The police department recently released their weekly recap of service calls for the period ending October 12, which highlights a variety of traffic incidents and safety responses across the city.

There is plenty to do in town over the next couple of days. Today, you can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, play trivia at The Mill or The Bogey Factory, or enjoy pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can look forward to ART House 360 events or trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company.
Looking at the weekly police report, on October 9, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash on USH 18/151 near mile marker 76, where a driver was cited for unsafe lane deviation.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM and remain open until 10:00 PM.
